title: Harden GitStatusPanel background refresh lifecycle
outcome: Background Git-status reconciliation can outlive an unmounted panel and publish stale status to its parent; it also clears user-visible action errors at refresh start, derives inconsistent cache/dedup scope keys across load paths, and keeps polling while the window is visible but unfocused. Make background loads lifecycle-safe, preserve displayed errors unless a user action supersedes them, use one canonical panel scope key, and avoid unnecessary unfocused polling.
acceptance: A deferred load resolved after unmount emits no state/callback; action and commit errors survive interval/focus/visibility reconciliation; all load paths use one scope key; polling is gated or slowed while unfocused; focused regression tests cover each behavior.
